page.layout: One column of text. Running head at the top. One marginal note in the right margin, beside the first question. No page number, catchword or signature printed.

main_text.l: CVr Mulierem interfecisse longè iniquius sit
quàm Virum; quanquam naturæ ratione mas
fœmina longè præstantior sit?
II.
Reo & Accusatori si suffragia numero fuerint pa-
ria, cur tamen Reum vincere legibus sancitum & co-
nstitutum sit? Ibidem num. 13. & 15.
III.
An Legibus, vel ex arbitrio boni Viri iudicandum
sit? 3. Polit. 11. Ius itidem scriptum, an vero Aequitas
in iudicijs nobis sequenda? 5. Nicomach. 10.
IV.
An Mulier iure posset Regnum obtinere? 2. Politicor. 4.
V.
An saepius Magistratus mutare, vel potius S. Lycur-
gu Lacedaemona perpetuo in officio manere condu-
cibilius sit? 5. Politicor. 10.
VI.
An exacto demum quadragesimo a conceptu die
Abortum arte vel violentia etiam provocantes, ho-
micidij lege teneantur? 2. de gen. an. 3. Comm.
VII.
An lethalia sint dicenda vulnera? Ex Hippocr. 6:
IIX.
An partus decimestres, undecimestres itidem, legi-
timi vel spurij dicendi sint? Herod. l. 6. A. Gell. l. 3. c.

l.i: 6. Cl. Lang. Epist. medic. l. 3. ep. 6.

main_text.l: IX.
An Virgine lac habente, ideo eam perperisse statuen-
dum sit? M. Cic. Hipp. 5. Aphorism. 39. D. Fuchs. Comm.
An deniq; Mola ex commixtione utriusq; sexus se-
minegeneretur? D. Holl. Galliar. Hipp.

page.notes: The running head is printed in small capitals with "iuridica." in italics on the second line. A roman "I." sits beside it at the top; it is not part of the head and is left out. The question numbers II to IX are bare numerals and are kept as paragraphs. "IIX." is printed that way and is left as printed. The reading "seminegeneretur" at the end is uncertain because the line breaks inside the word; it is best read as printed. A tiny mark at the bottom centre is too faint to read and is not transcribed.
